summary: One-character fix restores underscore prefix on generated setUpClass/setUpModule fixture names so they remain hidden from --fixtures output by default, matching pre-6.2.0 behavior and directly resolving the issue.

issues.description: Only covers the name generated in _make_xunit_fixture; if any other unittest fixture name generation path exists without the underscore it would be inconsistent, but no such path is evident in this file.
